description_en: Update the skill group information in the Cloud Customer Service System based on the AICCS instance ID and skill group ID. This API supports updating the skill group description and display name
description_zh: 根据AICCS实例ID、技能组ID更新悉犀客服工作台技能组信息。支持更新技能组描述、技能组对外显示名称
name: UpdateSkillGroup

parameters.help_en:
AICCS instance ID.  
You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview).
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Skill group ID.  

You can invoke the QuerySkillGroups (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/aiccs/developer-reference/api-aiccs-2019-10-15-queryskillgroups) API and check the SkillGroupId field in the response to obtain the skill group ID.  

This parameter cannot be updated.
parameters.help_zh:
技能组ID。

可调用QuerySkillGroups (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/aiccs/developer-reference/api-aiccs-2019-10-15-queryskillgroups)接口，查看返回参数的SkillGroupId，即技能组ID。

不支持更新
parameters.name: skill_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Skill group name.  
This parameter cannot be updated.
parameters.help_zh:
技能组名称。
不支持更新
parameters.name: skill_group_name

parameters.help_en:
Skill group description.  
This parameter can be updated.
parameters.help_zh:
技能组描述。
此参数支持更新
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Display name of the skill group.  
This parameter can be updated.
parameters.help_zh:
技能组对外显示名称。
此参数支持更新
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: Unique ID of the customer request. Used for idempotency validation. You can generate it by using a UUID.
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

Code.description_en: Status code. A return value of "Success" indicates that the request succeeded.
Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回Success表示请求成功

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call succeeded. Valid values:  
true: Succeeded.  
false: Failed.
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
